resolution: Found world_loader.zig (it's at the REPO ROOT, not framework/ — that's why earlier greps missed it). Completed Phase 3: grass now bakes into the no-V8 /compiled world. world_loader.zig: added SHAPE_GRASS=6, buildGrassBlade() geometry (mirrors GrassBlade.ts), a grass bucket in ShapeBatches/buildShapeBatches, a static grass instance node tagged scene3d_tex_key='~grass~' (routes to the grass pipeline), the streaming family+proto, and a whiten-skip for the ~grass~ sentinel so blades keep their per-blade root tint. worldGeometry.ts: INSTANCE_SHAPE_GRASS=6 + pushGrass() emitting blade rows. KEY FIX: discovered grass is painted into ChunkFloor/landform tile grids, not surfaceRegions, so grassPopulation.ts now reads world.landforms[].field.tiles (the real source) in addition to surfaceRegions, and pushGrass converts floors->landforms to match. Verified end-to-end: rjit game shot bakes 1988 blades (world instances 4566->6554), loader render proof GREEN, shot PASS; both hmsc-int and world_loader binaries rebuilt clean with self-shots PASS. Not committed (shared hot files touched by parallel sessions).
